candidates.rationale: Jesus teaches not to worry about tomorrow because each day has enough trouble of its own, calling us to focus on today's needs.
God provided manna daily in the wilderness, teaching Israel to gather only what they needed for each day rather than hoarding for the future.
Moses blesses Israel with the promise that their strength will equal their days, provision matched to present need.
God's mercies are new every morning, emphasizing daily renewed grace and faithfulness rather than bearing all burdens at once.
Those who wait on the Lord will renew their strength, highlighting ongoing, timely provision of strength as we need it.
